tracks.srt_text:
1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:09,240
Deep in the green countryside, a giant egg finally cracked open.

2
00:00:09,640 --> 00:00:15,840
Out tumbled a big, clumsy, grey duckling.

3
00:00:16,640 --> 00:00:20,920
The other farm animals laughed at him.

4
00:00:21,320 --> 00:00:26,600
They called him ugly and chased him away.

5
00:00:27,400 --> 00:00:36,240
Feeling very lonely, the poor duckling ran away into the wild marsh.

6
00:00:37,040 --> 00:00:44,360
Winter came with biting winds and deep, heavy snow.

7
00:00:44,760 --> 00:00:52,160
The shivering duckling hid all alone under a frozen log.

8
00:00:53,160 --> 00:01:00,200
At last, the warm spring sun began to melt the ice.

9
00:01:01,000 --> 00:01:11,760
He saw three beautiful, elegant white swans gliding gracefully across the pond.

10
00:01:12,560 --> 00:01:23,320
The duckling swam toward them, bowing his head in sadness.

11
00:01:24,120 --> 00:01:30,520
But in the clear water, he saw his own reflection.

12
00:01:30,920 --> 00:01:41,320
He was no longer a clumsy, dark grey bird.

13
00:01:42,120 --> 00:01:50,200
He had grown into a beautiful, magnificent white swan!

14
00:01:50,600 --> 00:02:01,800
With a joyful heart, he flapped his strong wings and flew into the bright blue sky.
